scope: Disposable local network-none container, owned namespace/veth pair, synthetic credentials, NET_ADMIN and SYS_ADMIN with container AppArmor/seccomp disabled; no host mounts, downloads, cloud execution, production edits, controller authority or traffic grants.
version_limit: Local fixture reports 6.1.0. Source pins the managed /opt/tunnex-ipsec/libexec/ipsec/charon to 6.1.0 and DaemonClient.Inspect requires VICI version 6.1.0. The package/CLI report 6.0.7-r1 does not identify that managed daemon. Root reports successful live Inspect; exact live binary attestation remains separate. This local matrix does not establish live Azure causality.

completed_cases.name: default_unique_simultaneous_initial_initiation
completed_cases.observation: Both peers had 2 ESTABLISHED IKEs and 2 INSTALLED children immediately after simultaneous initiation.

completed_cases.name: replace_with_connection_ifids_simultaneous_initial_initiation
completed_cases.configuration: unique=replace; connection and child if_id_in/out=701; child reqid=701; transport selectors 0.0.0.0/0
completed_cases.observation: Run 1: both peers retained 2 ESTABLISHED IKEs and 2 INSTALLED children at immediate and 12-second samples. Run 2: peer a retained 2/2 and peer b 1/1 at both samples.
completed_cases.conclusion: Candidate did not prevent duplicates and did not reliably settle them after the documented replacement overlap. Trigger timing remains unclassified; this does not prove the live Azure initiation sequence.

completed_cases.name: same_auth_identities_distinct_connection_ifids
completed_cases.observation: Sequential establishment of two owned configurations with interface IDs 701 and 702: after 12 seconds, both peers had 2 ESTABLISHED IKEs, one INSTALLED owned1 child and one INSTALLED owned2 child.
completed_cases.limit: Observed isolation for this configuration; not a general identity-admission or INITIAL_CONTACT isolation guarantee.

completed_cases.name: single_initial_ike_child_and_ike_rekey
completed_cases.observation: Successful native CHILD rekey command followed by a 2-second sample, then successful IKE rekey command followed by a 12-second sample: both peers retained 1 ESTABLISHED IKE and 1 INSTALLED child at initial and both settled samples.
completed_cases.limit: Cardinality observations and command success only; no production authority, packet continuity or transient overlap acceptance claim.

completed_cases.name: exact_id_cleanup_owned_policy_barrier_and_fresh_configuration
completed_cases.observation: After exact listed IKE-ID termination and connection configuration unload, both peers had 0 ESTABLISHED IKEs, 0 INSTALLED children, 0 SAD entries and 0 policies matching owned interface ID 701. Total SPD entries were 8 per peer; they are not counted as owned-policy absence. A fresh configuration name with interface ID 703 subsequently established 1 IKE and 1 child per peer.
completed_cases.limit: Fixture cleanup/recreate only; not normal API cleanup, journal generation finalization or global kernel-policy absence.

harness_false_starts: Namespace setup required container AppArmor/seccomp relaxation in addition to NET_ADMIN/SYS_ADMIN; the default-profile setup failed.

Rekey/cleanup harness initially used unsupported swanctl --unload-conns and then unsupported --load-conns --clear. Installed CLI help was checked; completed run used --load-conns with an empty configuration. Those earlier exits are harness failures, not daemon rekey failures.
An exploratory duplicated-IKE rekey/cleanup run terminated peer a before observing peer b; its later peer-b observations are excluded from the completed rekey case.
script_hash_scope: Hashes identify final local review snapshots, not immutable per-invocation snapshots. Scripts evolved during investigation; they are not claimed as exact replay hashes for every earlier observation. Original outputs were tool results; no raw daemon logs, credentials or SA material are included here.
decision: Do not ship this candidate as a duplicate-IKE prevention fix. Preserve strict duplicate/selector refusal. Live managed-binary attestation and normal owned lifecycle qualification remain separate.

version_source_evidence.correction: Earlier attribution of package-reported 6.0.7-r1 to the owned managed daemon was unsupported.
